v0.3.0.description:
## New:
- San Fierro and Las Venturas are added as goals:
    - *Yay Ka-Boom-Boom* (San Fierro, 18 story missions)
    - *A Home in the Hills* (Las Venturas, 22 story missions)
- Optional missions added as checks:
    - Zero's Missions - Air Raid, Supply Lines, New Model Army
    - Wang Cars - Zeroing In, Test Drive, Customs Fast Track, Puncture Wounds
    - The Caligula's heist
- Side activities added as checks:
    - Driving, Flying, Bike and Boat Schools - 1 check per test
    - Valet Parking (10 levels), Pimping (10 levels), Quarry (7 missions)
    - Import/Export (all 30 cars)
    - SF and LV Gyms
- Collectibles added as checks:
    - 50 San Fierro Snapshots
    - 50 Las Venturas Horseshoes
    - 50 Oysters (Only randomized if *A Home in the Hills* is the goal)
- New items:
    - Kung Fu and Kickboxing styles
    - Weapon Mastery
## Fixes:
- Fixed radar on mission markers disappearing while collectible blips are on.
v0.3.0.title: SanAndreasAP 0.3.0

v0.4.0.description:
## New:
- **Starting point** option was added:
You can now choose a starting point (_Badlands_, _San Fierro_, _Las Venturas_), instead of having to start every run on `In The Beginning`
You need a corresponding save file. Instructions on how to use these save files can be found [here](https://github.com/awakenbad/SanAndreasAP#using-starting-point-save-files)

## Changes:
- Excluding `Tags`, `Snapshots`, `Horseshoes` or `Oysters` will now remove their blips from the map.

## Credits:
All save files for starting points were created by **wafflejunkie**.
